people.name: Adrammelech
people.line: Assyrian god worshipped by Sepharvites in Samaria

people.name: Ivvah
people.line: City conquered by Assyria, people resettled in Samaria.

people.name: Sepharvaim
people.line: City of origin for people resettled in Samaria

translations.web: and the Avvites made Nibhaz and Tartak; and the Sepharvites burned their children in the fire to Adrammelech and Anammelech, the gods of Sepharvaim.
translations.bsb: the Avvites made Nibhaz and Tartak, and the Sepharvites burned their children in the fire to Adrammelech and Anammelech the gods of Sepharvaim.
translations.kjv: And the Avites made Nibhaz and Tartak, and the Sepharvites burnt their children in fire to Adrammelech and Anammelech, the gods of Sepharvaim.
translations.asv: and the Avvites made Nibhaz and Tartak; and the Sepharvites burnt their children in the fire to Adrammelech and Anammelech, the gods of Sepharvaim.
